items.markdown:
Scientific research does not support the widespread myth that Native Americans metabolize alcohol differently or have an inherent biological inability to process it . Studies comparing alcohol clearance rates and liver enzyme activity between Native Americans and other populations generally find no consistent metabolic differences.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX3acCvE1Ebb8a6WajG1WSKAHonb3k7b8HaT5eiuSBPlIH1yK7smP5Ndl6FbnP6-NGvwQFemmCyvrGPiDeQ6JymbqljoBjzbFzMJnhnyg2thKdHcZopmMzEQ7qoKTNCkHGUSY5ZU5vJrgXn1iIBzKd2yM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-mxl0KJ_GcH45lNGTY4I6HpqwF0TldoJV_yTqWmuow7S37ZqGmRHJxc2GCDMMpGDZRzZQuat8DhniuqEROQn2mMWm-MJZP3P1yEhQLbrABkqNNFUSeHrmBsDZVD4zE0ooOI7O4fgMG693sIFx1fZIaCNoOiUPdsfDu0hNGPYdvX)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXmIQyu7lsN33VNlnkWrMeg7clXz5XwHsZvNoLAMnPLWZTvhDREZbvBMxm--CM73wh6w4N-tEkumiAecsMt4ivmMX--kUKnWQfiNobtkH2_1JNHKuKWDGq9a151R70qS6O1Taf)

### Alcohol Metabolism and Genetics

- **Metabolic rates:** Controlled studies measuring ethanol clearance and liver alcohol dehydrogenase activity have found similar average metabolism rates across Native American and white participants. Research on alcohol response also does not support claims of heightened biological sensitivity based on Native heritage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1-mxl0KJ_GcH45lNGTY4I6HpqwF0TldoJV_yTqWmuow7S37ZqGmRHJxc2GCDMMpGDZRzZQuat8DhniuqEROQn2mMWm-MJZP3P1yEhQLbrABkqNNFUSeHrmBsDZVD4zE0ooOI7O4fgMG693sIFx1fZIaCNoOiUPdsfDu0hNGPYdvX)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXX3acCvE1Ebb8a6WajG1WSKAHonb3k7b8HaT5eiuSBPlIH1yK7smP5Ndl6FbnP6-NGvwQFemmCyvrGPiDeQ6JymbqljoBjzbFzMJnhnyg2thKdHcZopmMzEQ7qoKTNCkHGUSY5ZU5vJrgXn1iIBzKd2yM)
- **ALDH2 enzyme variant:** The *ALDH2* gene variant common in many East Asian populations—which slows acetaldehyde breakdown and causes an unpleasant flushing reaction—does not appear to be present in Native American populations.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXEuw3jBoK6ZgQl5G_WRAwZjv2bU6wdjOnSJAjoueNpPvxYIFXhab-koBlqnbR7g88R7iqxsWpMWKEii8w4QuKN_A1F0PIB0WrtDtWP8i3kV_Hl5HeOacsJGEAxTTGlAKE6Q5Wmuva1zi_)
- **ADH1B variants:** Genetic studies in specific tribal samples have observed *ADH1B* variants (such as *ADH1B*2* and *ADH1B*3* ), which are associated with protective effects against alcohol dependence in studied groups rather than heightened vulnerability.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXEuw3jBoK6ZgQl5G_WRAwZjv2bU6wdjOnSJAjoueNpPvxYIFXhab-koBlqnbR7g88R7iqxsWpMWKEii8w4QuKN_A1F0PIB0WrtDtWP8i3kV_Hl5HeOacsJGEAxTTGlAKE6Q5Wmuva1zi_)

### Individual and Social Factors

- **Physiological and drinking factors:** Blood alcohol concentration and intoxication effects depend on factors such as body weight, sex, lean body mass, stomach contents, drinking pace, and beverage strength.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX3cYWERtk-fiTgqZn9-aEpzKPJMA_m9z4CQBpCQMjaKq-847O8GW2nnBHS_j8PQmEtU1DFmo3Yi5Mz81iYxxIjAZH_TRNa1-t1FB7rnfsnGjmei68QPyKsTe5mbcpM1uMzWGF8NzfcQsOEgLsmefOSfNB)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESywEBxCJF13_9e3gMdFjk4nMlbfQ0qrjgt8vmlqZr_PeAHQfo_5xEmMw74dKkffm7celY_luJN8uIvOVlNuiGF9vDZXuU7mASaMFyI-nSMZZq8BUCm6b4afnSWS2oYJWJmVrRZW30sUh0_qczHRVtoiFXEcTsa-oTSEG78FrVIjhG9FYXQCVd0uLo22yj2lQwJwTJSM8mAwzHXSlgww7CH-giUBK4L_FSCOYWJjXFbN1ti4FGhPIlEGASTTrRPdqBRIDzkMyG3b_FR4WUDw)
- **Historical and social context:** Public health researchers attribute disparities in alcohol-related harm and alcohol use disorder to historical trauma, socioeconomic conditions, and healthcare access rather than innate differences in alcohol metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpwEBxCJF15HdaKco66ImgcCeyg-5c_9dBd9s1g0g0WLB8AsBVr3tiYQKYrUEbLrbi-kMQJbFV1PJzivH1lVru1wIyVFk3pkq9tJdSaddWSKBPNaLbKRrhW8EKpUlQE7P4rl8OhOtzsY2Dnubvh4XmjVo0HNNOkRMxG5tYQJUd2WLJWZ98dHYjO3ZQQ79beYUeqEMlrka9lUQztn8-r-ODN2pqoiMvUrrwA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXmIQyu7lsN33VNlnkWrMeg7clXz5XwHsZvNoLAMnPLWZTvhDREZbvBMxm--CM73wh6w4N-tEkumiAecsMt4ivmMX--kUKnWQfiNobtkH2_1JNHKuKWDGq9a151R70qS6O1Taf)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXZUvtRjbwa6ssrcOBzzmKvRthIoKTT-2DjukwXsmRqpNvjW7jG6Cv8FApCfQ_ApCnolLtM6UvA504nmlUMoISQMqrc-LhUcdC1cozHRAJWIzW3-QLFa9C7EnX5O1KJSAYkMDuR-OYRg)

For broader genetic context, see this review on [Evidence for a Genetic Component for Substance Dependence in Native Americans](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXEuw3jBoK6ZgQl5G_WRAwZjv2bU6wdjOnSJAjoueNpPvxYIFXhab-koBlqnbR7g88R7iqxsWpMWKEii8w4QuKN_A1F0PIB0WrtDtWP8i3kV_Hl5HeOacsJGEAxTTGlAKE6Q5Wmuva1zi_).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXEuw3jBoK6ZgQl5G_WRAwZjv2bU6wdjOnSJAjoueNpPvxYIFXhab-koBlqnbR7g88R7iqxsWpMWKEii8w4QuKN_A1F0PIB0WrtDtWP8i3kV_Hl5HeOacsJGEAxTTGlAKE6Q5Wmuva1zi_)If you want to explore this further, let me know whether you are interested in **enzyme genetics** (such as *ADH* and *ALDH* pathways), **research history** behind the "firewater" myth, or **public health and prevention** factors.
